'''Monn Tatth'''<ref name="LTFA">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref> was a [[Color|dark]]-skinned [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who spent time on the [[planet]] [[Jakku]] around thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]]. On Jakku, he was stood near<ref name="TFA" /> [[Venalo Wintz]] and the [[droid]] [[KT-310]]<ref name="DI3.0">''[[Disney Infinity 3.0]]''</ref> when he witnessed the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] knocking the [[First Order]] deserter [[Finn]] after chasing him through [[Niima Outpost]] with the [[astromech droid]] [[BB-8]] who had accused Finn of being a [[thief]]. The First Order [[Escape from Jakku|attacked]] Niima in search of BB-8 shortly after the incident. While on Jakku, Tatth wore a [[Color|black]] piece of headwear and white [[Clothing|robes]].<ref name="TFA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Monn Tatth first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']], which was released in [[2015]]. The actor playing the character was uncredited and the character did not receive a name in the film,<ref name="TFA" /> but was identified by the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'', which was released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="DI3.0" /> Despite the game being non-[[canon]], story group member [[Pablo Hidalgo]] confirmed on [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] that the names provided by the game for previously unidentified characters, including Tatth, were considered canon.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/749616406245699584|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2016-07-03|quote=@LelalMekha Yeah, same with Infinity.|archivefile=File:PabloHidalgo-LegoName-Twitter.png|nolive=1}} {{C|In response to: "@pablohidalgo <nowiki>youtube.com/watch?v=JwxAeHPLpPg</nowiki> The Lego game identifies a few BG characters from TFA, but are those names canonical?"}}</ref>
